input.label: bug
input.reply:
Thanks for the report and the repro. The error tells you to set `sequence.groupId`, but that option isn't in the public `SequenceOptions` type or the docs, so the message points at something you can't configure. That part looks like a real problem.

I couldn't search existing issues or read the source with the tools available here. So I haven't confirmed whether this is a known issue, or how `groupId` is derived internally.

The check itself looks intentional. Projects that share a pool group can't have different `maxWorkers`. As a workaround, you could try giving the projects different pool settings, such as a different `pool` or `execArgv`. Alternatively, set the same `maxWorkers` on every project. I haven't verified either of these.

A maintainer will need to decide whether to expose `groupId` or to reword the error message.
